answer is 0-based index. }catch(e){document.getElementById('quiz-loading').innerHTML=` Error: ${e.message} Try Again `;} } function renderQuestion(){ if(!quizData.length)return; const q=quizData[quizIdx],total=quizData.length,answered=quizAnswered[quizIdx],letters=['A','B','C','D','E']; document.getElementById('q-prog-text').textContent=`Q ${quizIdx+1} of ${total}`; document.getElementById('q-prog-bar').style.width=`${((quizIdx+1)/total)*100}%`; document.getElementById('q-label').textContent=`QUESTION ${quizIdx+1}`; document.getElementById('q-text').textContent=q.q; document.getElementById('q-options').innerHTML=q.options.map((opt,i)=>{let cls='';if(answered!==null){if(i===q.answer)cls='correct';else if(i===answered&&answered!==q.answer)cls='incorrect';}return ` ${letters[i]} ${opt} `;}).join(''); const expBox=document.getElementById('q-explanation'); document.getElementById('q-explanation-text').textContent=q.explanation; expBox.classList.toggle('show',answered!==null); document.getElementById('btn-prev').disabled=quizIdx===0; const isLast=quizIdx===total-1,btnNext=document.getElementById('btn-next'); btnNext.textContent=(isLast&&answered!==null)?'See Results →':'Next →'; btnNext.onclick=(isLast&&answered!==null)?showResult:nextQ; } function answerQ(i){if(quizAnswered[quizIdx]!==null)return;quizAnswered[quizIdx]=i;if(i===quizData[quizIdx].answer)quizCorrect++;updateLiveScore();renderQuestion();} function nextQ(){if(quizIdx 0){quizIdx--;renderQuestion();}} function updateLiveScore(){const answered=quizAnswered.filter(a=>a!==null).length;document.getElementById('live-score').textContent=`${quizCorrect}/${answered||quizData.length||0}`;const pct=answered?Math.round((quizCorrect/answered)*100):0;document.getElementById('score-bar').style.width=pct+'%';document.getElementById('score-pct-text').textContent=pct+'%';} function showResult(){ document.getElementById('quiz-active').style.display='none';document.getElementById('quiz-result').style.display='block'; const total=quizData.length,wrong=total-quizCorrect,pct=Math.round((quizCorrect/total)*100); document.getElementById('res-pct').textContent=pct+'%';document.getElementById('res-correct').textContent=quizCorrect;document.getElementById('res-wrong').textContent=wrong;document.getElementById('res-total').textContent=total; let grade,msg; if(pct>=90){grade='Excellent — Exam Ready';msg='Outstanding. You have a strong command of this topic and are ready for the licensing exam.';} else if(pct>=75){grade='Good — Nearly There';msg='Solid performance. Focus on the study guide before retaking.";} else{grade='Needs Work — Study First';msg='Review the study guide thoroughly before attempting another quiz.';} document.getElementById('res-grade').textContent=grade;document.getElementById('res-msg').textContent=msg; } // ── Flashcards ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── async function loadFlashcards(){ fcIdx=0;knownSet=new Set();flashcards=[]; document.getElementById('fc-known-count').textContent='0 known'; const state=getState(),topic=getTopic(); document.getElementById('fc-container').innerHTML=' Building flashcard deck...
